speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are presenting with rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass; let's begin by asking how long these symptoms have been occurring and if you are experiencing any changes in bowel habits or weight loss.

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Cancer. I have noted the patient's 2-week history of daily rectal bleeding and a palpable mass; this clinical picture is highly suggestive of colorectal malignancy. I am requesting a Colonoscopy with biopsy and a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease.
